---
title: "How do I check whether a measurement resembles earlier observations?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I check whether a measurement resembles earlier observations?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Keep observations in time order.

2. Plot the series and inspect trends.

3. Run acf() and describe which lags show a relationship.

## Runnable example

```{r}
set.seed(25)
x <- as.numeric(arima.sim(model=list(ar=.6),n=100))
plot.ts(x,col="#3F78A8",ylab="Simulated value",
        main="Example with time dependence")
acf(x,main="Autocorrelation by lag",col="#A35E20")
```

## Interpret the result

The simulation has positive serial dependence by design. The ACF displays lag-specific correlations; it does not certify that real observations are stationary.

## Check before applying to real data

ACF values can be distorted by trend, seasonality, irregular intervals, and short samples; review the time series first.
